en: Father in heaven how we love you We lift your name in all the earth
May your kingdom be established in our praises As Your people declare your mighty works!

ko: 전능하신 하나님 찬양 언제나 동일하신 주
en: Blessed be the Lord, God almighty Who was and is and is to come Blessed be the Lord, God almighty Who reigns forever more
I’ll lift the name of the Lord on high Just like a flag flown high in the sky I’ll lift the name of the Lord on high
